reasons.LIMITED_HISTORY: This seller is new or has few orders, so a reliable score cannot be given yet
reasons.ACCOUNT_ESTABLISHED: Account has been active for {value} days
reasons.ORDER_SURGE_7D: Unusually many orders in the last 7 days ({value})
reasons.FEW_ORDERS_7D: Only {value} orders in the last 7 days
reasons.ACTIVE_RECENT_ORDERS: Steady order flow in the last 7 days ({value} orders)
reasons.ORDER_SURGE_30D: Unusually many orders in the last 30 days ({value})
reasons.FEW_ORDERS_30D: Only {value} orders in the last 30 days
reasons.STEADY_ORDERS_30D: Steady order flow in the last 30 days ({value} orders)
reasons.BUYER_BURST: {value} different buyers paid in the last 24 hours
reasons.NORMAL_DAILY_BUYERS: Only {value} different buyers paid in the last 24 hours, a normal pace
reasons.MANY_BUYERS_30D: {value} different buyers in 30 days, unusually many
reasons.BROAD_CUSTOMER_BASE: {value} different buyers bought in the last 30 days
reasons.SUDDEN_BUYER_SPIKE: Buyers in the last 24 hours are {value} times this seller's usual daily number
reasons.STABLE_BUYER_FLOW: Buyer numbers match this seller's usual pattern
reasons.FEW_REPEAT_BUYERS: Almost no buyers came back to order again (only {value}%)
reasons.REPEAT_BUYER_CIRCLE: Unusually many repeat buyers ({value}%), possibly a small closed group
reasons.REPEAT_BUYERS: {value}% of buyers came back to order again
reasons.FEW_BUYERS_DOMINATE: A few buyers account for most of the orders
reasons.ORDERS_SPREAD_OUT: Orders are spread across many different buyers
reasons.HIGH_REFUND_RATE: {value}% of orders had to be refunded
reasons.LOW_REFUND_RATE: Only {value}% of orders had to be refunded
reasons.HIGH_DISPUTE_RATE: {value}% of orders ended in a dispute
reasons.LOW_DISPUTE_RATE: Only {value}% of orders ended in a dispute
reasons.FAST_CASHOUT: Money is cashed out within {value} of arriving
reasons.NORMAL_CASHOUT_RHYTHM: Money usually stays about {value} before it is cashed out
reasons.HIGH_TICKET: Orders cost {value} times the usual price for this kind of product
reasons.NORMAL_TICKET: Order prices are in line with this kind of product
reasons.SHARED_BUYER_GROUP: {value}% of this seller's buyers also pay one other seller, a possible coordinated group
reasons.NO_SHARED_BUYERS: Buyers are not shared with another suspicious seller
reasons.YOUNG_BUT_NOT_A_WARNING: Account is {value} days old, but being new alone is not treated as a warning sign
reasons.NO_ORDER_RUSH_7D: No sudden rush of orders in the last 7 days ({value})
reasons.NO_ORDER_RUSH_30D: No sudden rush of orders in the last 30 days ({value})
reasons.CASHOUT_NOT_UNUSUAL: Money stays about {value} before cash-out, which is not unusually fast
